rest_block.closed_form: th_h = A + theta_M/2, th_l = A - theta_M/2, A = arccos(cos(theta_D) cos(theta_M/2))
rest_block.order_of_the_two_steps: M_M M_D, M_D M_M and the palindromic M_D^(1/2) M_M M_D^(1/2) are conjugate: same rest phases
rest_block.palindromic_step: G M G = M^-1 with G the handedness: M = exp(-i K), K handedness-odd
rest_block.identities_checked: characteristic polynomial (five coefficients), root form, product rule, G M G = M^-1, unitarity: polynomial identities modulo the three circle relations

single_exponential_variant.rest_phases: sqrt(theta_D^2 + theta_M^2/4) +- theta_M/2; product theta_l theta_h = theta_D^2 exactly
single_exponential_variant.with_doublet_angle_theta_T: theta_l theta_h = |theta_D^2 - theta_T theta_M|, theta_l^2 + theta_h^2 = 2 theta_D^2 + theta_M^2 + theta_T^2
single_exponential_variant.majorana_matrix: [[theta_T, theta_D], [theta_D, theta_M]] on the left-handed fields (nu_L, N^c); rest phases = its Takagi values

light_phase.bound: 0 <= th_l <= (theta_D^2/2) cot(theta_M/2) for 0 <= theta_D <= pi, 0 < theta_M < pi (d th_l/d theta_D = sin(theta_D) cos(a)/sqrt(1 - cos^2(theta_D) cos^2(a)) <= theta_D cot(a), a = theta_M/2)
light_phase.admixture_of_the_singlet_in_the_light_le: amplitude ratio N^c : nu_L = tan(th_l/2)/tan(theta_D/2) = sqrt(tan(th_l/2)/tan(th_h/2)) (left block of the palindromic step; checked to 30 digits at 20 points); (theta_D/2) cot(theta_M/2) to leading order

period.tick: U_t = M S_t, M = M_D^(1/2) M_M M_D^(1/2), S_t the alternating routing of CF-1 section 8
period.identity: (U2 + U2^-1)/2 = ((Pi - 1)/2) 1 + ((Pi + 1)/2) cos(2 Theta), Pi = prod_i cos(2 p_i), cos(2 Theta) = (M^2 + M^-2)/2 with the two eigenvalues cos(2 th_l), cos(2 th_h), each four times, commuting with the routing
period.phases: cos(E2_j) = cos^2(th_j) Pi - sin^2(th_j), j = light, heavy; each sign twice (two helicities)
period.argument: M = exp(-i K) with K handedness-odd; singular value decomposition of its block gives a rotation of the species label that depends on the handedness only; the routing is diagonal in handedness and blind to the label, so the rotation commutes with it and the tick is the direct sum of two CF-1 ticks with mass angles th_l and th_h (reports R1, R3 apply to each)
period.conjugation: C = (Y_r sigma_2 tau_x) K: C H C^-1 = -H for the three generators and C alpha_i C^-1 = alpha_i: the block is the doubled (particle and hole) form of two Weyl fields

occupations_of_one_cell.Dirac_step: exp(-i theta_D sum_s (c*_(nu_L s) c_(N s) + h.c.))
occupations_of_one_cell.pairing_step: exp(-i theta_M (c_(N up) c_(N down) + h.c.)): a rotation by theta_M between the empty cell and the cell holding the spin-singlet pair of neutral singlets
occupations_of_one_cell.bogoliubov_identity: U^-1 c_m U = sum_n M[m, n] c_n with the 4 x 4 one-body step M = M_M M_D and the dictionary c_(N^c up) = -c*_(N down), c_(N^c down) = c*_(N up), c_(nu_L^c up) = c*_(nu_L down), c_(nu_L^c down) = -c*_(nu_L up): eight operator identities on the 16 states, symbolic in the two angles
occupations_of_one_cell.normalisation: the rest phase of N under the pairing step alone is theta_M
occupations_of_one_cell.empty_state: <empty| pairing step |empty> = cos(theta_M) per cell: the empty state is not stationary under a pairing step; with all 32 patterns as independent modes the link 11111 <-> 00000 is number conserving and fixes it

audit_form.fields: two left Weyl fields (nu_L, N^c) of the sixteen even patterns
audit_form.pair_matrix: Delta = epsilon x [[0, m_D], [m_D, M]], m_D = v y_nu (fourth Higgs channel), M the bare term
audit_form.identity: B(p)^2 = (|p|^2 + M_nu^2) on every Nambu row; E^2 = |p|^2 + m^2, m = (sqrt(M^2 + 4 m_D^2) +- M)/2
audit_form.reading: the continuum form of the product rule; the audit's massless neutral row is the case without the sixteenth state

tower_table.law: th_l = k theta_D^2 (1 - (theta_D^2/12)(1 + 12 k^2) + ...), k = (1/2) cot(theta_M/2) = (1/2) sqrt((1 + lambda)/(1 - lambda)) for theta_M = arccos(lambda)
